up: Retrieve all activity measurements from the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1794523 where the standard_relation is '=' (indicating an exact measurement). For each such measurement, provide the following fields: the canonical SMILES of the compound, the molecule ChEMBL ID, the standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Exclude measurements where standard_value is null. Return one row per activity record. Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1794523' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
